From: Oliver Yang <oliver.yang@orbitalhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@orbitalhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Cross-zone availability hub sync

Thanks again for the discovery call today — I wanted to capture next steps and lock a time for the technical deep dive (we'll pull in our platform and security folks from APAC).

Quick recap: Orbital Health is evaluating inference for clinical-text summarization (PHI scope — regional isolation required). Our CTO wants a 60-minute deep dive focused on: deployment topology, VPC/private options, and quantization tradeoffs for throughput.

People to include on our side: me (Oliver), Priya Rao (platform lead, SGT timezone), and our Head of Security (TBD).

Availability from our side (local times):
- Week of May 4–8: Tue/Fri mornings PT (8:30–10:30 PT) — best for US overlap
- Week of May 11–15: Tue/Thu afternoons CET (14:00–17:00 CET) — best for EU attendees
- Week of May 18–22: Wed mornings SGT (09:00–11:00 SGT) — APAC-friendly

We know a single recurring slot won't work for everyone long-term. Would you be open to a short pilot (4–6 weeks) where Redwood rotates the weekly meeting across time bands so each region gets at least two sessions within that window? If so, please propose a rotation pattern and a first date to lock the calendar.

I attached an attendee list stub and a short note from today.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this.

— Oliver
Orbital Health
attachments: attendee-list-orbital.csv (CSV small), call-notes-20260422.txt

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 18:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-zone availability hub sync

Thanks Oliver — great working session earlier. Happy to run the pilot rotation you suggested; below is a lightweight proposal so we can pick a start date and lock invites.

Proposal: 3-week rotating cadence (pilot length: 6 weeks = two full rotations)
- Week A (US-friendly): 09:30 PT / 12:30 ET (60 mins) — good window for US product + some EU overlap
- Week B (EU-friendly): 15:00 CET / 14:00 BST (60 mins) — mid-afternoon EU block; Redwood will have an engineer in CET
- Week C (APAC-friendly): 09:00 SGT / 11:00 AEST (60 mins) — matches Priya's morning and our APAC SE availability

First two candidate dates for the pilot kickoff (please confirm one):
- Option 1: Tue, 5 May 2026 at 09:30 PT (May 5 / 17:30 SGT)
- Option 2: Wed, 6 May 2026 at 15:00 CET (May 6 / 09:00 SGT)

Agenda (60 mins): 1) Architecture & deployment options (20m) 2) Performance/quantization tradeoffs (15m) 3) Security/data flows & KMS (15m) 4) Next steps/action owners (10m)

Operational notes: we recommend inviting the platform engineer (Priya), a security lead (if available), and one of our infra engineers for the deep-dive. We can own the calendar invites and create a shared doc for prompts & evals.

Ben — can you drop a Calendly poll for the group and include a HubSpot meeting link? Neha — please confirm Redwood's EU engineer availability for Week B rotations (I can send the recurring invites once we confirm).

On availability: I attached a short discovery PDF that outlines items we'll cover during the deep dive.

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
redwoodinference.com
